violations.description: Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Minor detail clean cabinets under coffee station. Dry coffee spill on shelves. Clean area where coffee spilled.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. To encourage proper hand washing. Ensure hand washing sinks are provided with proper paper towels.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. Self closing door not present.
Handwashing, good hygienic practices (5 pts deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
